import json
from pathlib import Path

CONFIG_MARKER = "hard-v3-config-path-16"

def load_mode():
    # Compute config path relative to this file's location
    config_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "config" / "settings_alpha.json"
    data = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return data["mode"]

from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v3-template-path-29"

def render_report(name):
    # Get the absolute path to this script
    script_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    # Navigate to project root (one level up from job_delta)
    project_root = script_dir.parent
    template_path = project_root / "assets" / "templates" / "summary_delta.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER
